raw_content.initial_message: I was charged 70$ and I never authorized it. If you don’t reverse it right now I’m filing a chargeback.
raw_content.context: Customer claims unauthorized charge. Policy: verify identity before discussing account details; do not accuse customer or confirm fraud without investigation; guide through steps: secure account, check recent logins/transactions, initiate dispute workflow, explain timelines, and provide next update time. Offer to freeze subscription renewals if applicable.

learning_objectives: Handle fraud disputes safely without confirming wrongdoing
Follow verification steps before account details
Explain dispute/chargeback implications and timelines clearly
correct_sop_steps: Acknowledge concern and reassure you’ll help; remain neutral
Verify identity using approved method before sharing billing details
Collect key details: date/time, amount, payment method last 4 (if customer volunteers), and whether they recognize the merchant descriptor
Secure the account: password reset, sessions revoke, enable MFA (if not already)
Initiate internal billing dispute workflow and share realistic timeline for investigation/refund decision
Explain chargeback consequences at a high level (may pause account/flags) without threatening; recommend dispute workflow first
Set next update time and provide case reference
common_mistakes: Confirming it is fraud without evidence
Sharing account/payment info before identity verification
Vague timelines or no reference number
sticky_notes: TRAP: Don’t say 'yes this is fraud' — keep it neutral.
HINT: Offer security steps immediately to reduce anxiety.

must_demonstrate: At least one account security action recommended
Dispute workflow + realistic timeline + reference number
bonus_points: Explains chargeback implications neutrally and recommends internal dispute first
Proactively checks for subscription renewal prevention

customer_persona_hints.starting_tone: Angry and anxious; wants immediate reversal
customer_persona_hints.secret_acceptance_condition: Will calm down if you start security actions + open dispute workflow and provide a concrete update cadence
